mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, increasing the present value of future cash flows and leading to positive 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it indicates a simultaneous contraction in manufacturing and housing, signaling a deepening economic slowdown that leads to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 AND HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) and weak labor market participation (PAYEMS < 137000 thousand), the S&P 500 is expected to have negative 20-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
regime_hint: high unemployment and weak labor market
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 137000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it indicates a weakening housing market and broader economic demand, leading to negative 5-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1600.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative 60-day forward S&P 500 returns due to reduced corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 2.5% annualized, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative 20-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it indicates a weak labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative 5-day forward S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.
